title: Review a diff
description: Sonnet reviews the diff, then a second Sonnet pass adversarially verifies each finding against the code before anything reaches the user. No code is changed.
when_to_use: Reviewing a PR, a branch, or the working diff, where the deliverable is findings rather than a change.

orchestrator.mandate: Decide what to review and adjudicate the verified findings. Delegate the reading and the reviewing. Never fix, commit, or push from this plan.

nodes.name: review-scope
nodes.description: The orchestrator identifies the exact diff under review, defaulting to the merge-base against origin/main, and states which review dimensions the diff actually touches.
nodes.produces: The diff ref, and the dimensions in and out of scope.

nodes.name: usage-scout
nodes.description: Traces how the changed code is called across the rest of the codebase, so findings about breaking behavior rest on real call sites. Run when the diff changes a shared or public interface.
nodes.produces: Call sites of the changed code, with paths.

nodes.name: diff-reviewer
nodes.description: Reviews the diff across the in-scope dimensions and reports every candidate finding with a file:line anchor and a severity marker, favouring coverage over self-filtering.
nodes.produces: Candidate findings with anchors, severities, and confidence.

nodes.name: finding-verifier
nodes.description: Tries to refute each candidate finding by checking it against the actual code at the diff's ref, and downgrades any claim it cannot back to a question.
nodes.produces: Per-finding verdict: confirmed, downgraded to a question, or refuted.
